title: Which Credited Days a Settled Change Reaches - TRICARE Retired Reserve Recall Paid-Month Credit
content:
For a TRICARE Retired Reserve plan under the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, which credited days the change in the recall paid-month credit applies to follows the period it covers: where the change credit or paid adjustment covers only part of the month, it applies only to the credited days from the first day it covers; where it covers the whole month, it applies to every credited day; otherwise it applies to no credited day.

**Terms.** Credited days run from the first day the recall paid-month credit counts through the last day of the month. A change covering part of a month runs from the DEERS event date to the month's last day. The change is applied at its daily figure once for each credited day it reaches.

**Cases (hypothetical, May, 31 days).**

1. Credited days 20 to 31 May; change credit covering 18 to 31 May (14 days): applies to 20 to 31 May, 12 days.
2. Credited days 20 to 31 May; change credit covering the whole of May: applies to all 12 credited days.
3. Credited days 20 to 31 May; no change credit and no paid adjustment: applies to no day.
